Debrief — your decisions

Flagged decisions are re-measured with paired rollouts: your move and the AI's preference play out across the same imagined worlds (opponent hands drawn from the network's belief), so the difference is a paired estimate. A verdict is only stamped when the gap clears twice its standard error — anything inside noise is a tie, whatever the point estimate says.
The opponent is the project's champion policy network running entirely in this page — the same weights the analysis console studies. Cards marked "seen" in your hand were drawn face-up, so the AI provably knows you hold them.
